findings.finding: Noise amplitude and delivery time are separate measurement properties; buffered fusion accounts for sensor delay, while additive noise models support controlled sensitivity tests.
findings.relevance: AL-021 ideal horizontal feedback passed missions but failed most pair and recovery gates
findings.direction_alignment: Improve realistic physics controller evaluation with an inspectable working demo
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Fixed synthetic noise and latency expose sensitivity but cannot establish hardware sensor accuracy or fused estimator performance
findings.engineering_cost: Four fixed qualities, strict delivery reconstruction, 24 new flights and nine paired 3D comparisons
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-022 evaluates noise and delay before changing control or fusion
findings.verification_needed: Reproduce all retained ideal traces, retain same-quality no-outage pairs and all failures; freeze parameters before final measurements

overall_recommendation: Measure separate and combined noise and delay with unchanged control and physics limits.
evidence_gaps: Three previously tested seeds; no independent validation cohort
No calibrated sensor, bias drift, outlier model, fusion or delay compensation
Ideal attitude and contact supervision remain; independent yaw refinement unresolved
